career_ladder.salary_growth_trajectory: Direct recruitment through the APSSB Combined Secondary Level Examination (CSLE) appoints candidates to Group 'C' subordinate positions across Arunachal Pradesh departments. Clerical & technical recruits (Lower Division Clerk / LDC, Data Entry Operator, Forester) enter at Central 7th CPC Level 4 (₹25,500 – ₹81,100), while uniform cadres (Constable Civil/AAPBn/Tax and Fireman) enter at Level 3 (₹21,700 – ₹69,100), and Laboratory/MTS cadres enter at Levels 1-2. Clerical personnel advance to Upper Division Clerk (UDC, Level 5), Assistant Section Officer (ASO, Level 7), Section Officer (SO, Level 8), and Under Secretary (Level 11) in the Arunachal Pradesh Civil Secretariat and directorates.

stages.stage_name: Stage 1: Objective Type Written Examination (OMR Multiple Choice)
stages.source_label: APSSB CSLE 2025 Scheme of Examination (Advt No. 04/25)

papers.paper_name: General Awareness: 25 Questions, 50 Marks (Current events, History, Polity, Constitution, Sports, Art & Culture, Geography, Everyday Science, Arunachal Pradesh state-specific topics)
General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 25 Questions, 50 Marks (Analogies, similarities, differences, space visualization, problem solving, analysis, visual memory, arithmetical reasoning)

Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 25 Questions, 50 Marks (Number Systems, Simplification, Decimals, Fractions, LCM/HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentage, Average, Profit & Loss, Simple & Compound Interest, Mensuration, Time & Work)

Test of English Language and Comprehension: 25 Questions, 50 Marks (Error spot, fill in blanks, synonyms, antonyms, spelling, idioms & phrases, one word substitution, sentence improvement, comprehension passage)

stages.stage_name: Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Skill Test

papers.paper_name: Physical Standard Test (PST) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Mandatory for uniform posts (Constable Civil Police, AAPBn, Tax/Excise, and Fireman). Candidates shortlisted in 1:8 ratio based on Stage-I marks. Qualifying in nature.
Skill / Typing Test: Mandatory for Lower Division Clerk (LDC) and Data Entry Operator posts (Minimum typing speed of 35 wpm in English on computer). Qualifying in nature.

stages.stage_name: Stage 3: Medical Fitness Test & Document Verification

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of original certificates (Class 10/12 marksheets, PRC, APST Certificate) and Comprehensive Medical Fitness Examination conducted by Government Medical Board.

financial_package.pay_level: Central 7th CPC Level 4 (₹25,500 – ₹81,100) for LDC / Level 3 (₹21,700 – ₹69,100) for Constable
financial_package.pay_source_label: APSSB Combined Secondary Level Examination Notification (Pay Matrix Scale)

official_perks.description: Dearness Allowance at 58% of Basic Pay (₹14,790 per month on entry basic of ₹25,500 as of 01.07.2025) as adopted by Government of Arunachal Pradesh.
HRA at 9% of Basic Pay (₹2,295 per month for Class-Z stations in Arunachal Pradesh) or government residential quarter allotment.
Special Duty Allowance at 10% of Basic Pay (₹2,550 per month) admissible to state employees serving in Arunachal Pradesh.
Transport Allowance of ₹1,350 per month plus 58% DA on TA (total ₹2,133 per month).
Tough location allowance for postings in remote, hilly, and border circle headquarters as per state finance norms.
Defined contributory pension under National Pension System (NPS with 14% Government contribution) and medical reimbursement under state health services rules.
